avis.titre: Nice enough but room for improvement
avis.texte: Felt nice on the eyes and seems hydrating enough, but made my eyes water all day and night.

I had really dry undereyes to the point where my skin would flake off and this product fixed that issue! Its fragrance free and great for sensitive skin. It also feels nice to rub under the eyes and the eyelids. Will definitely repurchase.

I wanted to like this product, and I like BYOMA products so much I thought I would, but once I used this my eyes started to sting immediately and it wouldn't stop until I washed my face. I returned it immediately, and will never purchase it again. Not recommended it you have sensitive eyes.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Byoma barrier repair eye cream is amazing. First of all, their packaging sits nicely on the countertop and is a cute reminder to do your skincare! The application lays very nicely into the skin. It absorbs well while leaving behind a perfect base for creaseless undereye makeup that lasts all day. I find the scent to be very mild and good for my mildly sensitive skin.

This Byoma barrier repair eye cream is amazing. First of all, their packaging sits nicely on the countertop and is a cute reminder to do your skincare! The application lays very nicely into the skin. It absorbs well while leaving behind a perfect base for creaseless undereye makeup that lasts all day. I find the scent to be very mild and good for my mildly sensitive skin.

This product is odorless, lightweight and glides on smooth. If you also plan to apply makeup after, rest assured, it won't affect your application. This is perfect for daytime use. I would definitely use a heavier eye cream for your night time skin care routine. Also perfect for those who are more mindful of clean ingredients. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

I bought this eye cream when I was buying a couple of other Byoma products that Nina Pool recommended. One review caught my eye and I figured it was affordable enough to give it a shot. I did not expect it to become a holy grail for me. My under eyes were dry and really creased. I'm in my late 30s and thought age was making it where I couldn't wear much concealer anymore without it creasing and having dry patches. This stuff changed everything!!! My undereyes are smooth and hydrated. I feel like it's taken a handful of years off my face. I've tried tons of eye creams from cheap to med spa grade and this one has worked far better than any others!

I have super sensitive skin- especially around my eyes. It seems like everything either makes my eyes sting and puffy or triggers an eczema flair up- especially whatever I use to try and make it better. This is the first/only product I've ever used that's actually helped and given me no problems. If you're anything like me and searching for relief- just get it

I'm not thrilled with this eye cream. It kind of doesn't sink in to your skin or at least it didn't for me. I have dry mature skin, and I wouldn't say my eyes are unusually dry, but this really didn't do much. and I think there's a design flaw with the packaging. Every time I would pump out product, there would be a little dry, hardened piece of product that came from the nozzle..kind of gross. I'm not gonna be repurchasing.
It stung really bad when it got in my eyes after washing my face at the end of the day :(

I loved the texture and promising ingredients, bur sadly caused irritation (itchy and slightly swollen undereye). By the time the irritation set-in, it was past the return window. I've used the hydrated serum in the past (the one in the blue bottle), and that one did not cause any issues when used on my undereyes.
I had purchased a pricey eye cream prior to buying this I like this one better it goes on smooth and moisturizes my eye area really good.

I've recently starting using this and love it already. It saved the skin in the corners of my eyes during the winter weather and after using a different eye cream that left my skin red, itchy and burning. I started using the Byoma and overnight it seemed to heal my previous reaction! Will continue to use this in my routine!!
So i bought this yesterday at my local Ulta and I used it last night. It was so rich for my skin and felt like a moisturizer. I will be repurchasing once I run out!
I love this eye cream. very light and I absorb easily. The price is so good. And I think it is an overall good choice for a person who is looking for an affordable eye cream.
tried so many different brands and never had any issues, for some reason it gave me some kind of allergic reaction. i stopped using but im still dealing with it!

avis.titre: I would buy this as my everyday cream
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this eye cream, definitely minimized the appearance of my fine lines and gave me a more even texture. Overall felt like the eye cream enhanced my skin and overall dryness

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] While this was hydrating, i feel like it just doesn't always dry all the way down no matter how much you use. It always feels a little tacky. If you were going to wear makeup over it, I would assume this wouldn't be a problem.

avis.titre: Just sits on skin, does not sink in
avis.texte: This product never sinks into skin, no matter how much it is gently patted in. I used it every night for 2 weeks, and woke up with sticky under eyes each day. Also, it burns like heck if you get any in your eyes, and my eyes are sensitive, so just using something that did not sink in caused them to tear up. The cream not sinking in also means it is not getting into deeper layers of skin, so I saw no difference after the 2 weeks of use. Each time you pump it out (1 pump is more than enough for both eyes, too much, actually) there is a hard piece that was left in the spout from the last time you used it that has to be thrown away.
I absolutely love this cream and my eyes feel amazing. It's soft and not irritating and very hydrating.

This barrier repair eye cream is a great eye cream to have on hand. I really love the packaging and the ingredients are clean and the texture is soft, super supple and penetrating. I would definitely repurchase.
I use this every night after my retinaldehyde eye serum. I use it during the day sometimes and it works great too. This eye cream keeps my delicate eye area free from irritation. I will repurchase.

If you have consistant dry, irritated, aging eyes this eye cream is for you!! I'll gove you some background- I just turned 30 in March, and I never had issues with dryness anywhere on my face especially the eye area. I always had oily lids. Well, after turning 30 I IMMEDIATELY got extremely dry eyes on my lids, corners, and underneath to wear they itched and even would be inflammed from rubbing them. So much dryness there were massive dry skin flakes after waking up. I let it go for a couple of weeks as I thought it would go away- nope. I was at my sister-in-law's house, and she had some Byoma products in rhe guest bathroom and used them. Love them!!! I went to Ulta to pick some of those items up the next day, and I saw this eye cream. It was so affordable and it said 'barrier repair' so I gave it a whirl. Y'all- this eye cream made my eyes back to normal after one use, overnight. I was AMAZED. I am going to keep using this product, as it's lightweight and made my eye area look better than ever. Also dermatologist recommended? Yes please! Coupons and ulta points work on it making this a no-brainer.

I love this eye cream. Im 43 years old. Ance prone t zone oily here but i have dry undereye. This is the best eye cream ive used so far that works for hydration and works soooo good under concealer/makeup! I use this day and night. At night use a retinol eyecream and then i layer this eyecream over it to lock in hydration. Sooooo good and affordable i mean what wlse can u ask for! Trust me you will love it!

avis.titre: First time trying this to combat allergies site effects
avis.texte: Allergy season is hitting really hard this year and the skin around my eyes is really suffering. This brings relief by moisturizing and combating redness and inflammation. It doesn't add additional irritation or is stinging while applying it so it's a win. I'm waiting for my skin to fully recover to see what else this eye cream can do. But overall it's helping me a lot

Unfortunately this causes my skin to breakout along my cheeks underneath my eye area whenever I apply it. It feels really nice and creamy, not too thick or uncomfortable. I love the pump, though the packaging itself is quite bulky which I'm not a fan of. Will be using this up on my body instead! 32/oily-combo skin

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First of all, I love skin products that have no scent and that alone makes me highly rate this product! The texture is lovely against my skin and doesn't feel like I'm adding extra weight. I haven't seen much of a difference, but will continue to use it!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review, and I am thrilled with the results! Some of the ingredients, like barrier lipids, copper tripeptide, and ectoin, were new to me, but together they work beautifully. Before using this product, the skin under my eyes looked dull and had a crepey texture. After just one week of applying one pump under each eye every morning after cleansing and toning, I noticed a significant improvement. My under-eye area appeared brighter and smoother, with less of a bruised look—it felt transformed. This product truly delivers results, just like every Korean beauty product I've tried. However, I do have one suggestion: the bottle design could be updated to hold more product, as this little bottle didn't last long for me. I liked it so much that I purchased another from Ulta right away! I highly recommend this amazing product. After reading more about the brand on their website, I have a better understanding of how these unique ingredients benefit the skin. I'm already exploring other BYOMA products—if you're looking for skincare that works, you should check them out too!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great product! Really hydrates the under eye area and leaves my skin feeling nourished. Packaging is also cute. No strong smell which is great!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this eye creme! It has a smooth texture that absorbs quickly and does not have a strong scent,which is refreshing. The nettle with the pump makes it easy to apply. I noticed a difference in my fine lines after a week that just kept improving!

avis.titre: My favorite cream from now on
avis.texte: I was about to repurchase my usual favorite eye cream for $25, but decided to give this one a try—and I'm so glad I did! The texture is rich and thick, which feels amazing under the eyes, and it provides just the right amount of hydration without feeling greasy. It absorbs well and keeps my under-eye area moisturized throughout the day. For the price, you really can't beat it. Definitely a new favorite in my skincare routine!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The packaging is pretty and the pump works well. It feels pleasant on my skin. It isn't greasy, absorbs nicely, and smells good. I haven't noticed any difference in my skin yet though.

I've been using the BYOMA Barrier Repair Eye Cream for a few weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed. The texture is lightweight yet deeply hydrating, and it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. It's super gentle on my sensitive under-eye area and leaves my skin feeling smooth, refreshed, and well-moisturized. I've noticed a visible difference in how bright and healthy my under-eyes look — less puffiness and dryness, and a softer, more even texture. I also appreciate the clean, minimal packaging and the skin barrier-supporting ingredients, which makes me feel good about what I'm putting on my skin. Definitely a new staple in my skincare routine. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a dependable, soothing eye cream that actually delivers.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't even know where to begin with this product. I personally have very dry, acne prone skin. I'm also in the process of integrating a retinol eye cream into my routine. This eye cream is very hydrating on its own, but this shines when it can complement a product. I will mix this with my retinol the cream and my under eyes have never looked better. For during the day, it's great as a makeup prep step and doesn't pill or get weird as well. For its price point it is a definite must try.

I had been looking for a cheap and effective under eye cream and was struggling until I found this product. It's super hydrating, texture is great, and easy to use! I used to get little dry patches under my eyes and now they're gone. I also noticed less creases when doing my under eye concelear. Love this product so much plus the bottle is super cute! I definitely recommend this for someone who needs a moisterizing eye cream without breaking the bank!!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Byoma Barrier Repair eye cream was great! It came in the cutest packaging! Felt great on the skin and made my under eyes visibly look better! I used this daily for a month, but I saw results after three days! This is a MUST TRY!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This eye cream is very hydrating and the perfect creamy texture. The packaging is great with easy to use pump. There is no scent which I love for a non irritating skincare product.

i've been using this product for about 2 weeks now. i love the packaging, its sleek and pretty. the pump is nice, and works well with the square design. it feels nice on my under eye but i honestly can't tell a huge difference right now, besides it being hydrating.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cream isn't greasy, it's light and very little to no smell which is great! It absorbs really nicely into the skin also! The packaging is cute and simple. I love it.

avis.titre: Received as a sample, would buy again
avis.texte: This cream comes in a cute rectangle shaped container in a pretty pink color. The pump squirts out just enough product to effectively cover your eye area. The product feels light on your skin and doesn't weigh you down. The ingredients feel very natural when applying.
The packaging was nice and scent was pleasant. It seems to be effective and it doesn't feel oily. It absorbs very well too. Would definitely buy this again.

I got this product free in exchange for my honest review. This eye cream is silky smooth, doesn't have any scent to it, and left my eyes feeling refreshed. Love the cute square packaging, and that a little goes a long way!

This eye cream is silky smooth, doesn't have any scent to it, and left my eyes feeling refreshed. Love the cute square packaging that fits nicely in my makeup bag. Great product and a little goes a long way!

I received this eye cream in exchange for my honest review. I have yet to be impressed with an eye cream, and I can add this one to that list. The eye cream didn't have any negative effects to my skin or anything, I just can't notice a difference. I guess my hunt still continues.

avis.titre: Great Cream, but not a Necessity!
avis.texte: I was sent this product in exchange for my honest opinions of the product. Cute Packaging like all other BYOMA products! I do like this eye cream and it feels very nice on the skin when applied. However, I have not seen significant changes to my under eyes since starting this product. If you are looking for a nice affordable eye cream, I would recommend this one but i also don't believe it is an absolutely necessary product for everyone.

This is a great product for fine lines and wrinkles. I like the pump, which makes it easy to apply. The texture is thin and absorbs well. It has no scent. The packaging is gorgeous. I received this product for my honest review.
llove the pump packaging. Very rich and creamy texture. Works great at hydrating my under eye and wears well underneath makeup! There is no noticeable scent. Worth the money 100%
Lightweight and fragrance free. Helped with brightness and also giving my under eye area a smoother appearance. This product was not irritating and will be going into my daily skincare routine.

I received this for free in exchange for my honest review. This eye cream is very thick and moisturizing. It doesn't have any scent that I noticed. My only complaint is that the cream clogs up the dispenser. I think it would work better in a squeeze tube instead of a pump.

The packaging is super cute. I love the matte pink and that the lid snaps on. Based on the instructions you only need 1 pump however one pump is actually pretty large amount for just the eye area. I suggest half a pump. Doesn't smell and is very moisturizing. I received this product for free for my honest review.

First thing is the Pink bottle is so CUTE!!! The texture was creamy and went on smoothly. I liked that it was unscented. I only needed a small drop for both eyes. It wasn't heavy. I Loved that the first ingredient was Aqua. I didn't have any irritation to using this product. But, I really didn't notice a big change in using it.

I was so excited to try this for the bags under my eyes. So far I haven't found anything to really help and sadly this was pretty much the same for me. I wanted to like it so bad! It's a nice creamy texture and comes in a cute, fun bottle. It absorbs nicely but I just didn't notice a difference in my under eyes. Hopefully, others did!

I recently tried the Byoma Barrier Repair Eye Cream, and I'm genuinely impressed with the results. From the very first use, I noticed how soothing and lightweight the formula feels on the delicate skin around my eyes. It absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue. One of the standout features of this eye cream is its ability to hydrate deeply. I often struggle with dry patches and fine lines around my eyes, and this product provided immediate relief, leaving my skin feeling soft and plump.

I've been using the Byoma Barrier Repair Eye Cream for a few weeks now, and overall, I enjoy using the product. The texture is lightweight yet deeply hydrating, and it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. I love that it's packed with skin-loving ingredients like ceramides and niacinamide, which have helped keep my under-eye area smooth and moisturized. The packaging is convenient, and a little product goes a long way. While I haven't noticed a dramatic change in dark circles, it does a great job at keeping my skin barrier strong and preventing dryness. If you're looking for a gentle, everyday eye cream that hydrates and soothes, this is a solid choice!

avis.titre: A nice, simple, hydrating eye cream
avis.texte: This is a fine, hydrating eye cream. I have fine lines & this did nothing for them but in a pinch, this will do. I think it would be perfect for someone who hates product but needs to protect the delicate skin around their eyes but isn't concerned about combating lines. Sometimes I get milia from rich creams & this one didn't do that, which is a testament to its formulation.

Very cute packaging! The product itself is very good. I like to use it in the morning vs at night but either works! Very creamy and blend able not to thick to feel like your pulling your skin. Sits beautifully under makeup after letting is soak in for about 5 minutes. No scent which my sensitive skin LOVES. 8/10 recommend!
I received this to review at no cost. Honestly this is just moisturizer. It's nothing crazy and I don't like the pump since product will gunk into the nozzle and come out really thick.

I've been using this eye cream for the last few weeks, and although I don't notice any remarkable difference, I do like it. I will continue to use it. It doesn't irritate my skin or leave behind any kind of residue. I was able to try this product free for my opinion and review.

Finally! After trying countless different products from various brands ranging from drugstore to luxury tier, I think I finally found an eye cream that I actually really like! The formula of this product is very lightweight, and not at all greasy. In addition, the consistency is similar to that of a gel, in which it is not thick nor heavy, but also not too watery. It felt very refreshing, & did not irritate my eyes or make them water (an issue I've had with other face products meant for the eye area, specifically moisturizers containing sunscreen). I was also impressed with the length of time in which my eye area actually stayed moisturized. Typically, the area below my eyes, and the skin directly on my brow bone begins to peel after 24 hours post moisturizer application. Since this is particularly true during the Spring & Winter months, I was pleasantly surprised when this product completely eliminated this issue while using it throughout the months of February & March. I would definitely recommend trying this eye cream!

Loving this eye cream by Byoma. The packaging is not only cute and convenient, but travel-friendly too. The combined ingredients help Increase elasticity and firmness around your eyes which is a plus for those with fine lines. The texture is rich and creamy but not at all heavy. Leaves my under eyes moisturized and supple. Works well under makeup and as an eye primer. It's affordable, unscented, and worth trying if you are lacking hydration and elasticity. (I received this product for free and testing purposes)

I was fooled by the lightweight packaging at first, expecting a barely there formula. But I found it surprisingly comfortable and capable of guarding against dryness in spring. I think it is a reliable eye cream overall.

I like this product a lot! I received it for free, but it is something that I will be buying again! It is smooth, lightweight, and feels good on the skin. It also does not have any noticeable sent (which I love!) so it feels very safe on the skin. A great eye product!

The texture is very nice, not too thick and not so watery, just right!! I like how it doesn't have a smell either. I also live the packaging, it is a bit hard to open, but that's no big deal. It absorbs well in your skin and doesn't feel like you have anything on
I received the BYOMA Barrier repair eye cream free for review . I really enjoy this cream. It leaves my under eye feeling moisturized and helps with the tired puffy look I wake up with.

I've used this for a few weeks now and I really like it. I do feel like my undereye area looks smoother and a little more even toned. I like that the cream is on the thicker side, a little goes a long way.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. The Byoma Barrier Repair eye cream is so rich and creamy, it leaves my eyes feeling hydrated and soothed without a greasy or heavy feel. The skin around my eyes can get so dry and irritated with the bitter cold wind and this barrier repair eye cream really helped restore my skin and relieve the dry red patches I had. I now have a better understanding of this brand and I recommend trying this eye cream!

I am always excited to try a new eye product because my eyes are definitely one of my issues on my face. After trying Byoma eye cream til I finished the product, I was looking for a slight difference, but unfortunately, I didn't see one. I do find it moisturizing but would like to see it more hydrating.

avis.titre: Nice texture feels good on sensitive skin
avis.texte: Has been working well for my sensitive rosacea prone skin. The pump works well and is convenient, provides the right amount per pump. I like the fragrance free scent, and the texture is like a thick gel that doesn't feel heavy. Can't tell how well it's working yet but I received as a promo so I will continue to use up.

I love the packaging of the Byoma barrier repair eye cream. The only thing is the pump distributes a lot of product. So you'll want to do a half pump. I love that it has no scent & is Vegan, has clean ingredients & cruelty free. I'm not sure of it effectiveness as I struggled to use the product. It made my eyes water & skin under my eyes slightly burn. I'm not sure if it was it mixing with my other brand moisturizer or what.

This eye cream absorbs nicely into the skin leaving your under eyes soft! This definitely helps with puffiness! My eyes were puffy one morning from crying the night before (PMS is the worst) so I applied this and within 30ish minutes I noticed the puffiness was gone!! I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

The packaging, the product, everything I really have loved! The scent and texture are both amazing. And I really feel like it's doing wonders on my fine lines!! I was gifted this item for my personal review!

BYOMA Barrier Repair Eye Cream! I've been trying to find something to help my dark circles under my eyes, so this was perfect! I felt like it moisturized my under eyes and helped overall with a smooth youthful appearance. Thanks for helping me no longer look like an old tired raccoon panda lol.

this little pink bottle is such a life changing product. it's perfect for traveling too. but this bottle made it look like i sleep like a baby when i barely get any sleep and it just evened out my eyebags and it's everything i needed and it doesn't feel greasy which is the best feeling

avis.titre: Non-Greasy Eye Cream to the Rescue!
avis.texte: I LOVE Byoma products and was excited to try this Barrier Repair Eye Cream. The texture is smooth and the formula absorbed nicely into the skin. I also love that Byoma products are made with clean ingredients. This will definitely be a regular part of my routine.

I enjoyed the texture it's a great eye moisturizer it doesn't peel or feel heavy however I don't feel like it does much more than that which is why I would recommend this for teens that enjoy having a skincare routine or anybody that doesn't have any skin problems and just want a little extra something.

I received in product in exchange for an honest review. I really like this eye cream. It goes on smoothly, has a really nice consistency, and absorbs quickly. Also, a little goes a long way and I only needed one pump of product for both eyes. It makes my under eyes look hydrated, and it's easy to layer makeup over it!

This added moisture under my eyes but really did nothing for the puffiness. It has no smell and is a relatively thin cream. The package is cute and pink easy to hold. I received this as a free sample.
This added moisture under my eyes but really did nothing for the puffiness. It has no smell and is a relatively thin cream. The package is cute and pink easy to hold.

avis.titre: Great eye cream for layering under makeup
avis.texte: This under eye cream has a great texture and slip - perfect for layering under makeup with no pilling. Rich enough for daytime for my dry and sensitive skin.

I liked that this product had a soft, smooth texture that went on thin and absorbed quickly. I also love that it's fragrance free! I also liked that the ingredients listed the specific reason why each ingredient is in the product, and the benefits each ingredient has. I definitely love the transparency with the ingredients, it makes you feel like there's better ingredients than similar products from different manufacturers. The only reason I didn't give it five stars is that I didn't really see a difference in my skin, other than the area seemed a little softer. Overall, it's a good product.

I love the simple packaging and the easy to use pump. I will say I think it gives you more product than necessary. I am also hopeful that most of this container is full as it is rather large for an eye cream. It's made for beginners as it shows you where it goes in the order of skin care routine and packaging isn't geared towards someone in their 50s. As for the cream itself, it had no scent and didn't burn my eyes. Also found it to feel quite luxurious and hydrating. Only reason it's not 5 stars as I feel it's a beginners eye cream and I didn't notice any results after 30 days.

This was a really nice eye cream that's wasn't too heavy. It is very lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin. I also didn't find it very fragranced so I didn't have any irritations. I found that my under eye felt very hydrated the next morning and throughout the day when using during daytime. The packaging was also easy to use.

I enjoyed this product, I used it for a few weeks, applied it before bedtime to hydrate overnight. It did a pretty good job in my opinion. I didn't notice any brightening under my eyes which I was hoping for. Had a nice texture, easy to apply. No scent that I could tell.
Perfect texture, and scent, very good absorbing, not greasy, very moisturizing. I like packing because so comfortable to use ! Ans I feel my skin under eyes more fresh !
Perfect texture, and scent, very good absorbing, not greasy, very moisturizing. I like packing because so comfortable to use ! Ans I feel my skin under eyes more fresh

The packaging is super cute, even though it seems as though there is next to no product inside with how light it is. I do notice improved hydration upon application, but as of yet have not seen any improvement in fine lines.

I didn't notice much of a difference other than it is very hydrating which is great. I like that it is not scented and seems to be great on my sensitive skin. Packaging is cute too. The steps on the side are helpful for people like me who are clueless about skincare and need guidance.

This was my first time trying a product from this line. The consistency on the eye cream was thick but blended easily. The pump helps get the product out a little goes a long way. I used this mostly as might but got great results this winter season. *I recieved this product for free in return for this review.

As a 43-year-old with dry skin, I'm always looking for an eye cream that truly hydrates without feeling heavy—and BYOMA's Barrier Repair Eye Cream delivers. The rich, creamy formula instantly soothes my tired under-eyes, locks in moisture, and sits beautifully under makeup without pilling. After consistent use, my skin feels smoother, fine lines appear softer, and my eye area looks more refreshed—definitely a new staple in my routine!

I received this product free to review The only downside? The packaging. The pump dispenses more product than needed, making it difficult to control the amount. A more precise applicator would improve the experience, as a little goes a long way with this formula. If you can work around the packaging, the formula itself is hydrating, soothing, and well-balanced for sensitive skin. A great choice for barrier support—just be mindful when dispensing.
I love how this eye cream is a rich textured cream yet it still pumps out of the tube effortlessly. When you glide it on your skin it hydrates the area exceptionally.

avis.titre: A good quality everyday eye cream
avis.texte: This was a very nice eye cream! It was hard to tell a huge difference in the appearance of my under eyes, but the product felt nice and moisturizing on my skin and did not cause irritation. I've enjoyed using this in my daily skincare routine

I didn't love this product as much as I had been hoping to. I felt that it effectively moisturized my skin, but fails to do much else. I had expected more brightening and wrinkle reduction and was a bit disappointed with its effectiveness. I liked the aesthetic of the bottle, but overall it felt a bit cheaply made. Overall this eye cream is effective at adding some extra moisture to the under eyes, but is nothing life changing.

I'm not sure I'm buying all of the claims (as listed on the Ulta page). Like I feel like this product applied and absorbed easily enough, and for a while, I thought it was on par with other eye creams I had been using. But, as I take a better look at my skin after using it for a month, I don't feel like this has helped with pigmentation or dark circles. I don't recall having either of these issues ever before (not sure this is the handiwork of past eye creams), but now that I've been using this, I'm seeing some darkness that I didn't know was there. As for all the other claims— barrier support, hydration, fine lines and firming— I guess it's doing those? I'm not totally sure. I'm not blown away by this product. I recieved this product in exchange for an honest review.

i've been using this product for a couple weeks now and have found the texture is really smooth and helps with fine lines. ive really seen a difference in the hydration under my eyes and less puffiness/lines. there is not really a scent to this product which I really enjoy so it would probably be good for sensitive skin. it absorbs really well and the packaging is super funky and cute. moisturizes amazingly. ingredients are great as well. would recommend to friends and use as a daily product for sure. price is on point for a great product.

I was sent this wonderful product for my honest review,so here it is.First off I have to say I really liked this eye cream,I'm still using it in fact.I love how creamy this is an it doesn't take much,so the product will last a while !! I also absolutely adore the packaging it's really cute an I'm sure alot of people would find it aesthetic.People who also don't like scented products will like this because I couldn't really smell any scent to it.I honestly do think this is a good product and I'd recommend it to people an id also purchase this to use in the future..... I'd like to take a look into there other products as well !!

The texture and effectiveness of this eye cream is very good. Highly moisturizing yet not heavy or irritating. Feels gentle on the skin. And the pink packaging in a rectangular container feels very chic. Product is also unscented.

The BYOMA brand Barrier Repair Eye Cream is mighty for its size. A little goes a long way. The formula is antioxidant rich, and very hydrating. The texture is creamy and goes on so smooth! Just a small dollop covers both eyes and doesn't feel heavy or greasy to the touch. My eyes felt well hydrated after using this product, and had no irritation or reaction for such a sensitive area of the face. No more tight dry tired eye bags. This product is a great addition to any skincare routine. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.
So hydrating and lightweight. Leaves my under eyes hydrated and plump. I don't know about brightening I guess I have to keep using it. Love that it has such good ingredients. Definitely recommend.

I've been using this eye cream for the past month, and the results are impressive! My undereye area is no longer dry or sagging—it's visibly brighter, and those dark circles have vanished. A tiny amount goes a long way with this product. I wholeheartedly recommend it!

Byoma barrier repair cream is great for moisturizing under eye and my under eye was more supple and smooth. I did not notice any changes to wrinkles, dark circles, or eyebags. I like that it's a pump because it's more sanitary however it uses so much product I finished an entire bottle in 3 weeks. I also had some issues initially with getting the pump to work. I received this product in exchange for an honest review.
Solid product. Moisturizes pretty well but I've used for almost a month and have not seen any improvements. I've used a few other similar products that I like a little better.

I like the pump but I feel like it dispenses too much product. The lotion does not seem to have a scent which I appreciate. It's nourishing enough for my dry skin during the winter. I also use a retinol and my under eyes get very dry. This seems to moisturize well!

(I received this product for free.) The texture of this product is super silky smooth. It is definitely moisturizing and that helps with plumping your skin, minimizing the appearance of fine lines. However, I did not notice any reduction in puffiness.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. The BYOMA Barrier Repair Eye Cream goes on after cleansing and toning along with your other serums and before your moisturizer. I liked that this was explicitly spelled out on the product packaging. A little of the eye cream goes a long way, as you only need half a pea sized drop. I found it to hydrate my under eye area and reduce puffiness really well, so I use it mainly in the morning. This is priced super reasonably. I'd definitely recommend it.
First off, I'm obsessed with the packaging of this product! The formula is also super hydrating, creamy, and moisturizing. A little goes a long way!

avis.titre: Love this for my aging skin
avis.texte: This eye cream is so amazingly light. I use it every morning and night. This pump will last quite a long time. I have noticed that under my eyes don't say as much. Loving the firmness!

avis.titre: The first eye cream i've used that doesn't cause issues
avis.texte: This is the first eye cream I've used that hasn't caused those little lumps to form under my eyes or have me react in any bad way. It's very very moisturizing, and I have noticed a difference in my fine lines under my eyes. They look less noticeable. I would definitely recommend this product.

I think this product has worked really well for my dark under eyes and I think I notice a difference after using it for a few weeks! It's not greasy and doesn't irritate my skin which is so nice. The only reason I gave it one star less is because of the packaging. It's hard for me to get the exact right amount I want with the pump. It's either too much or too little. Other than that, I definitely recommend it! I did get it for free to try but this is my honest opinion

This barrier repair eye cream is amazing! It is thick and luxurious feeling. It soaks in fast and is moisturizing. It is scentless. Thank you, @influenster and @byoma, for sending me this product #complimentary!

This product is very hydrating and moisturizing. Simple packaging and a good size. Very light scent. I'm sensitive to scents and this is fine for me. No issues after a week of use, but does everything I expected of it. I'd get it again!

I think this eye cream works nice! There isn't much of a scent to it and the packaging is very cute. It's a very silky cream that spreads and absorbs well. A little went a long way which is nice cause it will last a long time.

I've been using the BYOMA Barrier Repair Eye Cream, and it's quickly become a staple in my skincare routine! The formula is packed with barrier lipids, copper tripeptide, and ectoin, which are perfect for strengthening the skin barrier and keeping the delicate under-eye area hydrated. I love how lightweight yet nourishing it feels—no greasiness, just smooth, refreshed skin. After a few uses, I noticed my under-eyes looked more awake and less puffy. It's a great option if you're looking for a gentle, effective eye cream to enhance your skincare game. Definitely recommend!
My skin is very dry flakey. This eye cream on under my eyes feels very light weight not too heavy. It's Absorb on in my skin. Not too greasy. I don't feel any scent smell.

The ingredients are top of the line and not packed full of toxins like other brands. The texture leaves your skin feeling silky smooth. The results were very quick in my opinion about two weeks people could see my skin around my eyes looking younger. I didn't like the scent to much. Reminds me of like a doctor office.

avis.titre: I definitely will Buy this Product
avis.texte: Byoma Barrier Repair Eye Cream it has barrier lipids, copper, tripeptides, and ecotin all thing good for the skin. I have been using it for 3 weeks I love the cute packaging great to put on your make desk as well as great to have in your makeup bag for travel without worrying about breaking it or the size for air travel. Love the pump. You just had enough in one pump, so there is no waste. The eye cream is rich and moisturizing and does not burn or make my eyes water. I am 60 years old, so we have to moisturize around our eyes. There is no scent. I truly recommend it, and I will purchase it when I run out.

I received the BYOMA Glow Serum and Barrier Eye Cream for free in exchange for a review. I really like how moisturizing both products are—my skin feels soft and hydrated after using them. The eye cream is lightweight and absorbs well, and the serum gives a nice glow without feeling greasy. That said, I haven't noticed a major lasting difference in my skin yet, but I'll keep using them to see if that changes. Overall, they're nice for hydration, but I'm still waiting to see more long-term results!

avis.titre: Good product for undereye face yoga
avis.texte: I've never heard of this brand until I got it as a product to test. I ain't mad at it. The only thing I'd say is I personally think it pumps out a little too much product per pump than I'd prefer. But I did find that one pump on one finger and I use my other hand finger and kinda dab it together it evens out the product amount I'd like to use per eye. It's cream yet smooth enough to use as a good product for face yoga
This product does a good job of moisturizing my under eye and helping makeup go on smoother. I don't have many under eye wrinkles, so hard to comment on if this helps with lines.

This is a lot of bang for very little buck when it comes to eye creams! Cute packaging, and I appreciate a pump vs a pot when it comes to products for my eyes. I don't feel any tightening properties, but it is moisturizing and does not pull beneath makeup. I was very pleased to receive this in exchange for an honest review.
